0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (6-3, 7th in the West, on a two-game winning streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, 11th in the West, on a four-game winning streak) in the 10th game of Minnesota's season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while New Orleans is missing Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 132-126 home win on April 12, 2026.
